name: Suzutsuki Erika
source:
Generally lazy with a messy room. She often falls asleep during class. She's a mischevious talkative person. She hates studying, but somehow scores high on tests.

Yui always gets angry at her, but she doesn't really care. She loves potato chips so much that she can't let go of them. Even though she's taller, she likes to call Mio "Chibisuke".
